tasks.label: Install JDK 21 and configure Flutter
args: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $jdkRoot=Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'Programs\Temurin-21'; $archive=Join-Path $env:TEMP 'temurin-21.zip'; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $jdkRoot | Out-Null; Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'https://api.adoptium.net/v3/binary/latest/21/ga/windows/x64/jdk/hotspot/normal/eclipse' -OutFile $archive; Expand-Archive -Path $archive -DestinationPath $jdkRoot -Force; $jdk=Get-ChildItem $jdkRoot -Directory | Select-Object -First 1 -ExpandProperty FullName; if (-not (Test-Path (Join-Path $jdk 'bin\java.exe'))) { throw "JDK installation not found under $jdkRoot" }; & (Join-Path $jdk 'bin\java.exe') -version; & 'C:\develop\flutter\bin\flutter.bat' config --jdk-dir=$jdk; & 'C:\develop\flutter\bin\flutter.bat' doctor -v
